 # padawan-testing
 For testing Padawan - see github/sweagentd
 
+## Overview
+
+This repository is used for testing Padawan, the AI coding assistant.
+It contains various sample files and configurations for development testing.
+
+## Features
+
+- **Easy Setup**: Get started quickly with minimal configuration
+- **Fast Execution**: Optimized for rapid testing cycles
+- **Great Documentation**: Comprehensive guides and examples
+- **CI/CD Ready**: Pre-configured GitHub Actions workflows
+
+## Installation
+
+To get started with this project, follow these steps:
+
+1. Clone the repository:
+   ```bash
+   git clone https://github.com/github/padawan-testing.git
+   cd padawan-testing
+   ```
+
+2. Install dependencies:
+   ```bash
+   npm install
+   ```
+
+3. Run the development server:
+   ```bash
+   npm start
+   ```
+
+## Usage
+
+Here's a quick example of how to use the testing utilities:
+
+```javascript
+import { TestRunner } from './src/runner';
+
+const runner = new TestRunner({
+  verbose: true,
+  timeout: 5000
+});
+
+runner.execute('my-test-suite');
+```
+
+## ASCII Art Mascot
+
+```
+    __
+   <(o )___
+    ( ._> /
+     `---'
+```
+
+Meet our friendly duck mascot! 🦆
+
+## Contributing
+
+We welcome contributions! Please see our [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)
+for more details on how to get started.
+
+## License
+
+This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE)
+file for details.
+
